convert_json_folder_to_csv: run the CLI tool to convert all JSON files in a folder to CSV files in an output folder
convert_single_json_to_csv: run the CLI tool to convert a single JSON log file to a CSV file
parse_json_file: create a function that reads and parses a JSON file and returns the data or None on error
process_json_file: create a function that processes a robot experiment JSON log file and exports metrics to CSV
export_to_csv: create a function that writes a dictionary of results to a CSV file with keys as headers
